summary: Aspect C: the judgement becomes a signature-based differential in which ischemia (shape, time course, heart-rate relation, depth) and each alternative (heart-rate related only with an actual heart-rate change, early repolarization, position, conduction, noise, reference) count only through their own positive signature elements, generic and record-constant facts are excluded, and a fixed ischemia-count by alternative-strength table sets p_ischemic.
